sources.note: Homepage describes integrated healthcare platform with EMR, telehealth, e-prescribe, scheduling, billing, dictation. Pricing tiers from Free to $299/provider/month. Tagline: 'more than telehealth — where patients & providers connect.'
About page: healthcare technology company providing innovative software to providers and patients. Mission to develop fully-integrated software at minimal or no cost.

Critical page. Describes product as 'specifically designed for the post-acute and primary segment of care' for skilled nursing facilities, home health, and primary care. Notes self-developed software optimized for its own provider group. Uses EMR Direct Interoperability Engine. Lists all certified criteria.
Provider-facing page identical to homepage content. Same feature list and pricing tiers.

Provider T&C. Reveals: $300/physician/month fee, records retained 6+ years then archived 4+ years, lab/imaging integration available on request, providers are independent contractors, de-identified data may be used for statistics/marketing.
Privacy policy. Data collected includes: business name, federal tax ID, SSN, DOB, email, phone, health information, credit card info. Standard HIPAA compliance language.
Patient registration page. Collects username, password, email, first/last name, DOB, gender (Male/Female/Other/Unknown), mobile number. Requires agreement to Terms, Privacy Policy, and HIPAA terms.
Standard HIPAA BAA. InteliMD acts as business associate handling PHI. Mentions data aggregation services for healthcare operations.
ZoomInfo listing. Confirms Phoenix, AZ headquarters address. Describes mission to develop fully integrated software for healthcare at minimal/no cost. Mentions telemedicine services.
Trademark filed March 2018, registered under Class 044 (Medical services) for 'Telemedicine'. Owner: InteliMD PLLC, Laveen, AZ.

LinkedIn profile identifies Eric Ruggles as President & Board Chair of InteliPsych, described as 'the telepsychiatry arm of InteliMD.' InteliPsych specializes in crisis telepsychiatry with on-demand psychiatric evaluations.
Capterra listing exists but returned 403 — no review content accessible. Confirms product is listed in software directories but with no visible reviews.
D&B listing for inteliMD PLLC in Laveen, AZ. Page timed out; minimal info available.
